name: Hexerei
desc: Hexerei is a team bonus effect introduced in version Luna III. When 2 or more Hexerei characters are in the party, certain talent and weapon passives are enhanced.

value.name: Moonsign
value.desc: Moonsign is a team bonus effect introduced in Luna I. Depending on the number of Moonsign characters in the party, it activates or enhances the skills of those characters, as well as the effects of some Weapons and Artifacts.

imgDesc.text: Complete Witch's Homework-related quests to unlock additional Talents for the corresponding characters. Certain characters' skills and constellation effects will also change.
Each Witch's Homework Quest is focused on a specific character. Obtain the corresponding character and increase their level to Lv. 70 to unlock their related quest.

customize.text: Overview

Certain characters have a "Witch's Eve Rite" Additional Talent which is unlocked after completing their respective Witch's Homework quests. After completing these quests, the character becomes a Hexerei character. If 2 or more Hexerei characters are in the party, it will enable Hexerei: Secret Rite, which activates passives on Hexerei characters and weapons.
Unlocking Witch's Eve Rite Passive
To unlock the Witch's Eve Rite Additional Talent, you need to complete the quest
to obtain

customize.name: The Little Witch's Dictionary
customize.desc:
Received from Alice, this dictionary was created by the witches. Though it claims to explain a storybook of fables titled The Little Witch and the Undying Fire, it is actually filled with homework tailored by the Hexenzirkel for each reader.
As they say, "To defy the current is to learn." Embark on your journey with your companions and seek the crown of elevation!

customize.text: . The quest begins in the library at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters. Afterwards, character specific quests need to be completed to unlock the Additional Talent on the Hexerei characters. This can be accessed through either the character's Talent menu or through The Little Witch's Dictionary item. The player must own the character and said character has to be a minimum of Level 70 before the character specific quests can be accessed.
Characters
<color=#ffffff>Witch's Eve Rite Additional Talent</color>

customize.name: Venti
customize.desc: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
While Venti's Elemental Burst is active, nearby active characters that trigger a Swirl reaction will gain 50% DMG Bonus and Venti's burst will deal 135% of its original DMG.
Constellation Changes
Constellation 1: Fires 2 additional arrows per Aimed Shot, each dealing 33% of the original arrow's DMG.
Additionally, 2 extra arrows that track opponents will be fired per Windsunder Arrow, each dealing 20% of the original arrow's DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 0.25s.
Constellation 2: Elemental Skill decreases opponents' Anemo RES and Physical RES by 24% for 10s.
Additionally, after unleashing the Elemental Burst, Venti gains the Wherever a Breeze Blows effect, and the cooldown for his Elemental Skill is reset. After a Windsunder Arrow hits an opponent, there is also a 25% chance for Venti to gain the Wherever a Breeze Blows effect.
Wherever a Breeze Blows
When pressing to unleash the Elemental Skill, 300% of the original amount of DMG is dealt. This effect lasts for 15s and is removed after Venti presses to use Elemental Skill.
Constellation 4: After unleashing his Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Venti and his own active party members gain a 25% Anemo DMG Bonus for 10s.
Constellation 6: Targets who take DMG from Venti's Elemental Burst have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.
Additionally, the DMG Venti deals to these opponents will gain a CRIT DMG Bonus of 100%.

customize.name: Klee
customize.desc: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
When Klee deals DMG with her Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills or Elemental Burst, she will gain a stack of Boom Badge for 20s. Only 1 Boom Badge can be obtained for each of the three attack types and they have individual timers. While Klee has 1/2/3 Boom Badges, her Charged Attacks deal 115%/130%/150% of its original DMG.
Constellation Changes
Constellation 1: Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash's DMG.
For 12s after triggering the above effect, Klee's ATK is increased by 60%.
Constellation 2: When Klee's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, that opponent's DEF will be decreased by 23% for 10s.
Constellation 4: An explosion will be triggered if Klee leaves the field while Sparks 'n' Splash is active or when Sparks 'n' Splash ends, dealing 555% of ATK as AoE Pyro DMG. If Klee is on-field when the explosion occurs, its DMG will be increased by 100%.
Constellation 6: While under the effects of Sparks 'n' Splash, Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s. When Sparks 'n' Splash is used, all party members will gain a 10% Pyro DMG Bonus for 25s.
Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
When Klee uses an Explosive Spark, there is a 50% chance it will not be consumed. Additionally, while Sparks 'n' Splash is active, Klee's Normal Attacks have a 40% chance on the first and second hits to consume an Explosive Spark, dealing an additional attack equivalent to Boom-Boom Strike to her opponent(s).

customize.name: Albedo
customize.desc: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
When Albedo hits an enemy with his Elemental skill within 20s of casting it, he can generate up to 2 Silver Isotoma that last 10s.
One of the Silver Isotomas can generate Transient Blossoms when there are no Solar Isotomas on field.
After creating a Solar Isotoma, party members' Normal, Charged, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 4% per 1000 of Albedo's DEF up to 12%.
Hexerei party members get an additional 10% per 1000 of Albedo's DEF, up to 30%.
Constellation Changes
Constellation 1: Transient Blossoms generated by Albedo's Elemental Skill regenerate 1.2 Energy for Albedo.
Additionally, the use of Albedo's Elemental Skill also increases his DEF by 50% for the next 20s.
Constellation 2: Transient Blossoms grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s:
Unleashing Albedo's Elemental Burst consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Elemental Burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF. Fatal Reckoning can stack up to 4 times.
Additionally, when Albedo is not on the field and when the stack count of Fatal Reckoning reaches 4, all stacks of Fatal Reckoning are consumed. This generates 3 Fatal Blossoms near your character, which will violently bloom to deal AoE Geo DMG equal to 300% of Albedo's DEF, DMG that will also be considered Elemental Burst DMG. Where the Passive Talent Homuncular Nature has also been unlocked, the Elemental Mastery of nearby party members will also increase by 125 for 10s.
Constellation 4: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.
Additionally, when a nearby active character on the team jumps near a Silver Isotoma, the Silver Isotoma will be destroyed while greatly increasing the height of that jump, and for the next 3s, said character will deal 30% more Plunging Attack ground impact DMG. This effect is removed 0.1s after Plunging Attack ground impact DMG is dealt.
Constellation 6: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a shield created by Crystallize have their DMG increased by 17%.
Additionally, use of the Elemental Burst destroys all Silver Isotomas present on the field, and whenever a Silver Isotoma is destroyed this way the current instance of Elemental Burst will also remove 4 stacks of Fatal Reckoning from the Constellation 2. This increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossom by 250% of Albedo's DEF for the next 20s.

customize.name: Mona
customize.desc: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
When Mona's Normal or Charged Attacks hit an opponent, she gains a stack of Astral Glow of Mercury for 8s, up to 3 stacks. When a party member triggers Vaporize, all stacks are consumed to increase the damage of that Vaporize by 5% per stack.
When Mona's Normal or Charged Attacks hit an opponent, Mona's Elemental Burst Omen duration can be increased by 2s each time, every 0.5s, up to 8s.
Constellation Changes
Constellation 1: When an opponent affected by Omen is hit, Hydro-related elemental reactions are enhanced for 8s:
Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Vaporize, Hydro Swirl, and Lunar-Crystallize DMG are all increased by 15%. Freeze duration is extended by 15%.
When off-field party members trigger the above effect, the DMG Bonus is enhanced to 160% of its original effect.
Constellation 2: When a Normal Attack hits, there is a 20% chance that it will be automatically followed by a Charged Attack. Additionally, within 5s after Mona unleashes her Elemental Burst, her next Normal Attack that hits an enemy will automatically trigger a Charged Attack. This Charged Attack effect can only occur once every 5s.
When Mona's Charged Attack hits an opponent, all nearby party members will have their Elemental Mastery increased by 80 for 12s.
Constellation 4: When party member attacks an opponent affected by Omen, their CRIT Rate is increased by 15%; when any Hexerei party member attacks an opponent affected by Omen, they gain an additional 15% CRIT DMG.
Constellation 6: While Mona is the active character, when she enters Illusory Torrent or there are opponents affected by an Omen nearby, she gains a 60% increase to the DMG of her next Charged Attack per second. A maximum DMG Bonus of 180% can be achieved in this manner. The effect lasts for no more than 8s.
Additionally, the DMG Mona's Charged Attacks deal to opponents affected by an Omen will be increased to 200% of the original DMG.

customize.name: Durin
customize.desc: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
Dragon of White Flame can now reduce enemy RES by 35% for the elements involved in Pyro reactions that are not Vaporize or Melt.
Dragon of Dark Decay now increases Durin's Vaporize and Melt DMG by 70%.

customize.name: Varka
customize.desc: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
While Elemental Skill state is active, Normal Attacks will reduce the CD of his Elemental Skill by 1s.
Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
Increases the DMG dealt by Hexerei Characters' Arcane Projection by 300% of Nicole's ATK.

customize.name: Lohen
customize.desc: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
When the special Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst is unleashed, if Lohen's Will to Win at 50% or more of its max limit, his Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG will be increased by 40% for 6s.

customize.name: Fischl
customize.desc: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
When Oz is on-field, if an Overload reaction is triggered, all party members' ATK is increased by 22.5% for 10s.
When Oz is on-field, if either Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reaction is triggered, all nearby active members gain 90 Elemental Mastery for 10s.
Constellation Changes
Constellation 6: Extends Oz's duration on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character with each hit dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as Electro DMG.
After Oz performs a coordinated attack, the ATK and Elemental Mastery Fischl grants allies is increased by 100%.

customize.name: Sucrose
customize.desc: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
After Sucrose uses Elemental Skill, nearby party members' Normal, Charged, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 5.71428% for 15s.
After Sucrose uses Elemental Burst, nearby Hexerei party members Normal, Charged, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 7.14285% for 20s.
Constellation Changes
Constellation 6: If Elemental Burst triggers an elemental absorption, all party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus for the corresponding absorbed element during the skill's duration. All Hexerei characters gain an additional 8.57142% for the corresponding absorbed element.

customize.name: Razor
customize.desc: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

customize.text: Complete

Razor's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 70% of his ATK.
Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
While Razor's Elemental Burst is active, if the Electro Sigils from his Elemental skill overflow, a lightning strike is called down to deal 150% of Razor's ATK as Electro DMG and restore 7 Energy to Razor. This can be triggered once per 1s.
Constellation Changes
Constellation 6: Every 10s, Razor's next Normal Attack releases lightning that deals 100% of Razor's ATK as Electro DMG.
Lightning strikes on an opponent will grant Razor 3 Electro Sigils for his Elemental Skill. Additionally, when Razor gains Electro Sigils through his Elemental Skills, he gains 3 instead.
For 15s after consuming Electro Sigils, Razor's CRIT Rate is increased by 10% and CRIT DMG by 50%.

customize.name: Prune
customize.desc: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

customize.text: Complete

Activate Hexerei: Secret Rite
After a Hexerei character in the party affected by the Tolling Rally effect triggers an Elemental Reaction on an opponent, Prune's ATK is increased by 60% for 5s. If the Elemental Reaction triggered is a Swirl Reaction, the triggering character's ATK will additionally be increased by 30% for 5s.
Weapons

customize.name: Athame Artis
customize.desc: A precious sword gifted by the Day King to the brave hero in the little witch's story, only for the witch to take it and defeat the hero herself.

customize.text:
Day King's Splendor Solis
CRIT DMG from Elemental Bursts is increased by <color=#37ffff>16%/20%/24%/28%/32%</color> . When an Elemental Burst hits an opponent, gain the Blade of the Daylight Hours effect: ATK is increased by <color=#37ffff>20%/25%/30%/35%/40%</color> . Nearby active party members other than the equipping character have their ATK increased by <color=#37ffff>16%/20%/24%/28%/32%</color> for 3s.
Additionally, when the party possesses Hexerei: Secret Rite effects, the effects of Blade of the Daylight Hours are increased by an additional 75%. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

customize.name: The Daybreak Chronicles
customize.desc: The songs of resistance come hither on the wind to settle as gentle tones upon these strings, their combined power great enough to rip boundless darkness asunder with the light of the breaking dawn.

customize.text:
Ode Beyond Time
The equipping character gains Stirring Dawn Breeze: 3s after leaving combat, Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG is increased by <color=#37ffff>60%/75%/90%/105%/120%</color> . While in combat, this DMG Bonus will decrease by <color=#37ffff>10%/12.5%/15%/17.5%/20%</color> per second until it reaches 0%. When the equipping character's Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts hit an opponent, the DMG Bonus for the corresponding DMG type is increased by <color=#37ffff>10%/12.5%/15%/17.5%/20%</color> until it reaches <color=#37ffff>60%/75%/90%/105%/120%</color> . This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s for each of the attack types mentioned above. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
Additionally, when the party possesses Hexerei: Secret Rite effects, when the equipping character's Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills or Elemental Bursts hit an opponent, the DMG Bonus for all these DMG types is increased by <color=#37ffff>20%/25%/30%/35%/40%</color> instead.

customize.name: Gest of the Mighty Wolf
customize.desc: Legend has it that this greatsword was forged by the hand of Ravenwood, who inherited the name of Boreas, prior to his ascension to knighthood.

customize.text:
Indomitable Chivalry
Increase ATK SPD by 10%. Every time the equipping character's Normal Attack(s) hit opponent(s), when they cast their Elemental Skill, or when they begin their Charged Attack(s), gain 1/2/2 stacks of Four Winds' Hymn respectively: DMG dealt is increased by <color=#36ffff>7.5%/9.5%/11.5%/13.5%/15.5%</color> , for 4s. Max 4 stacks. This effect can be triggered once every 0.01s.
Additionally, when the team has the "Hexerei: Secret Rite" effect, each stack of Four Winds' Hymn will increase the CRIT DMG of the equipping character by <color=#36ffff>7.5%/9.5%/11.5%/13.5%/15.5%</color> .

customize.name: Angelos' Heptades
customize.desc: A golden box as splendid as the light of the heavens. According to legend, it once belonged to a divine envoy of the Eternal Court.

customize.text:
Crown of the Final Scion
ATK is increased by <color=#36ffff>12%/15%/18%/21%/24%</color> . After the equipping character creates a Shield, they gain "Pathfinder's Light" for 20s: Increases your active party member's DMG by <color=#36ffff>10%/13%/16%/19%/22%</color> for every 1,000 ATK the equipping character has, up to a maximum of <color=#36ffff>26%/34%/42%/50%/58%</color> . Additionally, when the equipping character creates a Shield, they will also gain "Guide's Contentment": Restores <color=#36ffff>14/15/16/17/18</color> Elemental Energy to the equipping character. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 14s, and can also be triggered when any type of chest is opened outside of combat. The equipping character may trigger this effect even when they are an off-field.
Hexerei: Secret Rite: When your own Hexerei character is off-field in the party, they will also gain 50% of the DMG increase from Pathfinder's Light.

customize.name: Disaster and Remorse
customize.desc: A polearm forged from Whitestone and Starsilver. Its keen point is constantly enveloped in a bone-piercing chill.

customize.text:
Dolorous Stroke
After the equipping character uses an Elemental Skill, they gain "Path of Conflict" for 17s, as well as "Unforgivable" and "Irreparable" for 3s each. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
Unforgivable: Increases the equipping character's Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by <color=#36ffff>40%/50%/60%/70%/80%</color> .
Irreparable: Increases the equipping character's Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG by <color=#36ffff>40%/50%/60%/70%/80%</color> .
While Path of Conflict is in effect, when the equipping character hits an opponent with a Normal Attack or Charged Attack, Irreparable's duration will be increased by 1s. When the equipping character hits an opponent with their Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Unforgivable's duration will be increased by 1s. Each of the above effects can be triggered once every 0.1s. When Path of Conflict ends or the equipping character leaves the field, both Unforgivable and Irreparable will be removed.
Hexerei: Secret Rite: The above DMG boosts are increased by 75%.
Artifacts

customize.name: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

customize.text:
4-Piece Set
After a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst hits an opponent, gain the Blessing of Pastoral Winds effect for 6s: ATK is increased by 25%.
If the equipping character has completed Witch's Homework, Blessing of Pastoral Winds will be upgraded to Resolve of Pastoral Winds, which also increases the CRIT Rate of the equipping character by an additional 20%. This effect can be triggered even when the character is off-field.

4-Piece Set
If the equipping character has completed Witch's Homework, after they use an Elemental Skill, they also gain "Light's Guidance" for 20s: All nearby party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to the equipping character's Elemental Type. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. DMG Bonuses provided by Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.
When your party has the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, Light's Guidance is upgraded to "Mortal Hymn": All nearby party members gain a 40% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to both the equipping character and the current active party member's Elemental Type instead. If both characters have the same Elemental Type, these bonuses will not stack.
